Subject: Request: Net60 & VAT evidence — Mediex PO 4321

Hi Soojin / Ben,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call yesterday. Procurement asked me to confirm whether Redwood can accept Net60 for the first three invoices tied to PO 4321 while our cash collection window aligns (we have a large receivables inflow in early May).

We also need the invoices to include the supplier VAT registration number and a breakdown suitable for our reclaim process (line-level VAT and total). Can you confirm what VAT fields Redwood will populate?

I'm attaching the PO for reference. If Net60 isn't possible, would Redwood consider a mixed approach (Net45 with a small reserve holdback)? We want to avoid delaying the product rollout.

Appreciate a quick confirmation — procurement has a tight review this week.

Best,
Elisa Torres
Head of Procurement, Mediex Corp
Elisa.Torres@mediex.com

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Elisa Torres <elisa.torres@mediex.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:47:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 & VAT evidence — Mediex PO 4321

Hi Elisa — thanks for sending the PO and context. Quick answer up front: we can be flexible, but we usually require one of the following for extended Net60 terms on new accounts: a) a 20% deposit on the first invoice, b) an agreed credit reserve held for the first 60 days, or c) an approved credit limit and signed amendment.

Given you need a short runway, here's a pragmatic proposal we can ship today if it works for you (see attached one-page term split):

- Option A (preferred): Net45 for standard invoices + 20% deposit on first invoice (applied as credit on subsequent invoices).
- Option B (compromise): Net60 on first three invoices with a 10% credit reserve held and released after invoice + VAT documentation verified.
- Option C (finance-approved): Net60 with an automated payment method on file (ACH/SEPA) + 1.5% early-pay discount for settlement within 30 days.

VAT: we will include Redwood Inference EU VAT number (GB999999999 or applicable local VAT depending on billing entity) and line-level VAT on each invoice. We need your EU VAT number and invoice contact to ensure reclaim fields align. Please send a scanned VAT certificate or business registration (a photo or PDF is fine).

Next steps if you like Option B (fastest to approve): we will prepare a short amendment for signature (DocuSign) and set up a credit reserve account; Marissa will create the invoice schedule. Can Ben and Marissa confirm the operational parts below?

- Marissa: proposed invoice sweep cadence (we recommend 2x monthly for cashflow alignment)
- Ben: confirm approval path for holding a 10% reserve and internal limits

Happy to hop on a 15-min call tomorrow to finalize.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Head of Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
Attachment: 2027-03-22-term-split-proposal.pdf

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, Elisa Torres <elisa.torres@mediex.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 15:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 & VAT evidence — Mediex PO 4321

Looping in finance details — we can approve Option B (Net60 first three invoices with 10% reserve) under these guardrails:

- Credit cap: initial credit limit of EUR 120k tied to PO 4321 items. If spend approaches 75% of limit, we trigger a review and either increase or require prepayment.
- Reserve handling: 10% reserve held for 60 days in Redwood-controlled escrow; released after invoice verification and VAT reclaim evidence (proof of payment to your end).
- Invoice cadence: we recommend biweekly invoice sweeps (1st/15th) to align with your internal remittance runs; this reduces per-invoice overhead and reduces outstanding days.
- Payment method: SEPA mandate preferred for EU. If SEPA not possible, card on file + re-auth for each cycle.

One additional commercial incentive: if invoices from Mar–May settle within 30 days 75%+ of the time, we can grandfather Net45 going forward.

Please confirm acceptance of these guardrails and share the VAT certificate and preferred remittance contact. Once we have that, I will generate the short amendment for signature.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Elisa Torres <elisa.torres@mediex.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@mediex.com
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 08:31:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 & VAT evidence — Mediex PO 4321

Thanks Ben & Soojin — that structure should work in principle. A couple of clarifying points from procurement/AP: 

- The reserve: Mediex is OK with a 10% reserve held by Redwood, provided we get an itemized reserve release schedule (preferably automated: invoice -> 30 days -> 60 days).
- VAT certificate: attached — EU VAT number is DE123456789. Please ensure the invoice shows both our VAT and Redwood's VAT number and a clear VAT amount per line.
- SEPA mandate: we'll send our SEPA details to accounts-payable@redwood.com; can Redwood confirm the SEPA creditor ID used for mandates?

If you can send the amendment today (DocuSign) we will aim to turn it around within 24 hours and route payment for the 20% deposit if Option A ends up being necessary.

Elisa
